name: @mnemosyne_os/agent-transcripts
description: Read what coding agents already write on disk: a declarative connector format, an interpreter that never evaluates it, and the liveness rules that keep "last seen" from becoming "working".
author: Tony Trochet <tony@xpacegems.com> (https://xpacegems.com)
_access: A SCOPED package publishes as restricted by default. Without this, the publish succeeds and the package is invisible to everyone but this account — a 404 for every reader.
_exports: Source, deliberately. Both consumers compile TypeScript already (vite for the cartridge, tsup for the MCP), and a dist to keep in step is a dist that goes stale between them — the failure this repo has already paid for. The `/node` entry is separate so a browser build never pulls node:fs.
